p2.title: USYD 学生紧急补助最高 2000
p2.body:
11 月 24 号官网发的，讲一个学生 Jasmine 意外两个月没法打工，靠补助交上了学费。

原文：The Student Bursaries Fund provides emergency financial assistance of up to $2,000, helping students overcome immediate challenges that might otherwise interrupt their education.

注意原文没写申请条件和国际生能不能申，需要的话直接问学校 Student Life 💡
p2.tags: #悉尼大学 #USYD #留学省钱 #澳洲生活 #澳洲大学

p3.title: 求助学生 3 年涨了 60%
p3.body:
官网原文：the number of students seeking financial assistance from the University's Student Life team has increased by more than 60 percent, with around 150 students now reaching out every month.

还有一句：Since 2021, the cost of being a student in Australia has risen by 29 percent.

我这学期房租也涨了，开始认真记账了。
p3.tags: #悉尼大学 #USYD #澳洲生活成本 #留学日常 #澳洲大学

mp.title: USYD 学生紧急补助基金最高 $2,000，求助学生 3 年增长超 60%；USYD 学者获 2026 总理科学奖
mp.lead: 本周 USYD 官网发布两条消息：Student Bursaries Fund 学生紧急补助的故事，以及 2026 总理科学奖获奖情况。下面逐条拆，原文都对着官网核过。

newsBodies.h2: 01 Student Bursaries Fund：最高 $2,000 紧急补助
paragraphs: 11 月 24 日，USYD 官网发布学生 Jasmine 的故事。她因意外两个月无法工作，申请到补助后 the money arriving in her account within days，用来交清学费并买日用品。
官网原文：The Student Bursaries Fund provides emergency financial assistance of up to $2,000, helping students overcome immediate challenges that might otherwise interrupt their education.

官网还写到：In just three years, the number of students seeking financial assistance from the University's Student Life team has increased by more than 60 percent, with around 150 students now reaching out every month. 原文未写明申请条件和国际学生是否适用，有需要的同学请以学校 Student Life 官方页面为准。

newsBodies.h2: 02 USYD 学者获 2026 总理科学奖
paragraphs: 11 月 24 日，USYD 官网发布 2026 Prime Minister’s Prizes for Science 获奖消息。官网原文：The University is the only institution to have more than one recipient named this year.
Georgina Long 教授获 Prime Minister’s Prize for Science，官网称她的黑色素瘤研究 improved survival tenfold for people with stage IV melanoma and 24-fold for those with brain metastases.
另一位获奖者获 2026 Malcolm McIntosh Prize for Physical Scientist of the Year，研究方向是碳捕集：His creation of a new acidic reactor system to prevent this loss converts industrial CO2 emissions into ethylene.
